subject: Retrieving RPKM, FPKM, AND TPM   values

messages.author: af0f3ed83b3e5190
messages.subject: Retrieving RPKM, FPKM, AND TPM   values
parts:
Hello  I did pair-ended RNA-seq, how can I convert my read count numbers  generated by feature counts into RPKM,  FPKM, and TPM values ? I'm currently using subread1.5.3

Thanks

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Retrieving RPKM, FPKM, AND TPM   values
parts: Subread does not offer functions to calculate these values. You will have to use other tools to calculate them or you can calculate them yourself. The rpkm() function in Bioconductor package edgeR can help you to calculate rpkm and fpkm values.
